            default: [],
            load: proc do |store, setting|
              store.clear

              # Ensure uniqueness first
              setting.uniq!

              # Sort the array with numeric values first, then alphanumeric values
              setting.sort! do |a, b|
                # Extract numeric part from each item
                a_num = a.to_s.match(/^\d+/) ? a.to_s.match(/^\d+/)[0].to_i : Float::INFINITY
                b_num = b.to_s.match(/^\d+/) ? b.to_s.match(/^\d+/)[0].to_i : Float::INFINITY

                if a_num == b_num
                  # If numeric part is the same, place alphanumeric values after pure numbers
                  a.match?(/\D/) ? 1 : -1
                else
                  # Sort by numeric value first
                  a_num <=> b_num
                end
              end

              setting.each do |text|
                spell_no = text.to_s[/^\d+/]

                if spell_no.nil?
                  setting.delete(text)
                else
                  iter = store.append
                  iter[0] = Spell[spell_no].num
                  iter[1] = Spell[spell_no].name
                  iter[2] = '     Vibrant' if text.to_s =~ /v/i
                end
              end
            end,
            delete: proc do |_, selected, setting|
              if selected.get_value(2).nil?
                setting.delete_if { |item| item == selected.get_value(0).to_s || item == selected.get_value(0) }
              else
                thing = setting.find { |item| item.to_s =~ /#{selected.get_value(0)}\s?+(?:v|vib)/i }
                setting.delete(thing)
              end
            end,
            set: proc do |_, text, setting|
              next if setting.include?(text)

              spell_no = text[/^\d+/]
              next if spell_no.nil?
              next if Spell[spell_no].nil?

              setting.push(text)
            end

      def self.get_category(key)
        @@categories.each { |category, data| return category unless data[key].nil? }
        nil
      end

      def self.get_setting(key)
        cat = Setup.get_category(key)
        return nil if cat.nil?

        @@categories[cat].each { |setting, data| return data if setting == key }
        nil
      end

      def validate_settings
        # set default values if they don't exist and correct Integer, Float and String types if saved settings are wrong class
        @@categories.each do |_, data|
          data.each { |key, value|
            if @settings[key].nil?
              @settings[key] = value[:default]
            elsif @settings[key].class != value[:default].class && !@settings[key].is_a?(TrueClass) && !@settings[key].is_a?(FalseClass)
              if value[:default].is_a?(Integer)
                @settings[key] = @settings[key].to_i
              elsif value[:default].is_a?(Float)
                @settings[key] = @settings[key].to_f
              elsif value[:default].is_a?(String)
                @settings[key] = @settings[key].to_s
              else
                echo("Key: #{key} default value class #{value[:default].class} does not match current class #{@settings[key].class}")
                echo("Report this to Elanthia-Online team!")
              end
            end
          }
        end
      end

      def initialize(settings)
        super()
        @settings = settings
        version = ELoot.get_script_version
        validate_settings

        # remove settings that doesn't exist
        @settings.delete_if { |key, _| next Setup.get_category(key).nil? }

        # use a GTK Builder to setup all the basics of the window then expand on that base
        return unless defined?(Gtk) && Gtk::Version::MAJOR == 3

        Gtk.queue do
          # add_from_file("#{$data_dir}eloot.ui")
          add_from_string(Setup.eloot_ui)
          load_settings
          set_initial_conditions
          set_tooltips

          self['main'].keep_above = true
          self['main'].set_title "ELoot Setup v#{version}"

          # connect signals after settings are loaded to a bunch of handlers don't trigger
          connect_signals { |handler| method(handler) }
        end
      end

      # iterate all objects and for any that match a setting name directly we set the default
      def load_settings
        Gtk.queue do
          # load up the generic settings which are just matching by name of the widget
          objects.each do |obj|
            next unless obj.methods.include?(:builder_name)

            key = obj.builder_name.to_sym
            next if (setting = Setup.get_setting(key)).nil?

            if obj.is_a?(Gtk::CheckButton)
              obj.active = @settings[key]
              obj.signal_connect('toggled') { on_update(obj) }
            elsif obj.class == Gtk::Button
              if key == :tipping_test
                tipping_test
              end
            elsif obj.class == Gtk::Entry
              obj.text = @settings[key].strip
              obj.signal_connect('changed') { on_update(obj) }
            elsif obj.class == Gtk::TextView
              obj.buffer.text = @settings[key].to_s.strip
              obj.buffer.signal_connect('changed') { on_update(obj) }
            elsif obj.class == Gtk::SpinButton
              obj.value = @settings[key]
              obj.adjustment.value = @settings[key]
              obj.signal_connect('changed') { on_update(obj) }
            elsif obj.class == Gtk::ComboBoxText
              if obj.builder_name =~ /gem_locker|alchemy_locker/
                on_locker_load(obj.builder_name)
              else
                obj.active_id = @settings[key]
                obj.signal_connect('changed') { on_update(obj) }
              end
            elsif obj.class == Gtk::TreeView
              next unless treeview_check(key)

              store = self["#{key}_store"]
              add = self["#{key}_add"]
              delete = self["#{key}_delete"]
              entry = self["#{key}_entry"]

              setting[:load].call(store, @settings[key])

              add.signal_connect('clicked') do
                next if entry.text.empty?

                setting[:set].call(store, entry.text, @settings[key])
                setting[:load].call(store, @settings[key])
                entry.text = ''
              end

              delete.signal_connect('clicked') do
                next if obj.selection.selected.nil?

                setting[:delete].call(store, obj.selection.selected, @settings[key])
                setting[:load].call(store, @settings[key])
              end
            end
          end

          # checkboxes for array storage with id's <setting>:<value>
          # this is primarily used by the loot types
          objects.each do |obj|
            next unless obj.methods.include?(:builder_name)
            next unless obj.builder_name =~ /^([^:]+):(.*)$/i
            next unless obj.class == Gtk::CheckButton

            key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
            value = Regexp.last_match(2).to_s

            next if Setup.get_setting(key).nil?

            obj.active = @settings[key].include?(value)

            # add in hook
            obj.signal_connect('toggled') do
              @settings[key].delete(value)
              if obj.active?
                @settings[key].push(value)
                @settings[key].uniq!.sort!
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end

      def treeview_check(key)
        msg = []
        setting = Setup.get_setting(key)

        msg << "*** No :load defined for #{key}" unless setting[:load]

        %w[store add delete entry].each do |suffix|
          msg << "** Failed to find #{suffix} for treeview #{key}" unless self["#{key}_#{suffix}"]
        end

        return true if msg.empty?

        msg.each { |error| respond error }
        return false
      end

      def tipping_test

          rows << [{ value: "Box depositing starts at 1", colspan: 4, alignment: :center }]
          rows << :separator

          second_half = (50..100).step(5).to_a

          max_length = [first_half.length, second_half.length].max

          # # Add nil entries if the second half is shorter
          first_half += [nil] * (max_length - first_half.length)
          second_half += [nil] * (max_length - second_half.length)

          max_length.times do |i|
            first_item = "#{first_half[i]}  "
            second_item = "#{second_half[i]}  "

            tip_1 = first_item ? Sell.locksmith_tip(first_item, @settings[:base_tip], @settings[:max_tip], @settings[:alpha_rate]) : nil

      def manage_hoard(key = nil, type = :all)
        types = type == :all ? [:gem, :alchemy] : [type]

        types.each do |t|
          type_prefix = t.to_s
          valid_keys = [
            "#{type_prefix}_everything_list".to_sym,
            "#{type_prefix}_only_list".to_sym,
            "#{type_prefix}_horde_locker".to_sym,
            "#{type_prefix}_horde_locker_che".to_sym
          ]

          # Return early if key is provided but not in valid_keys
          next if key && !valid_keys.include?(key)

          keys = key ? [key] : valid_keys

          keys.each do |k|
            case k
            when :"#{type_prefix}_everything_list"
              if self[k.to_s].active?
                self["#{type_prefix}_only_list"].active = false
                @settings[:"#{type_prefix}_only_list"] = false
                enable_all(self["#{type_prefix}_everything_frame"])
                disable_all(self["#{type_prefix}_only_frame"])
              end
            when :"#{type_prefix}_only_list"
              if self[k.to_s].active?
                self["#{type_prefix}_everything_list"].active = false
                @settings[:"#{type_prefix}_everything_list"] = false
                enable_all(self["#{type_prefix}_only_frame"])
                disable_all(self["#{type_prefix}_everything_frame"])
              end
            when :"#{type_prefix}_horde_locker"
              if self[k.to_s].active?
                self["#{type_prefix}_horde_locker_che"].active = false
                @settings[:"#{type_prefix}_horde_locker_che"] = false
                self["#{type_prefix}_locker"].set_sensitive(true)
                toggle_che_widgets(type_prefix, false)
              end
            when :"#{type_prefix}_horde_locker_che"
              if self[k.to_s].active?
                self["#{type_prefix}_horde_locker"].active = false
                @settings[:"#{type_prefix}_horde_locker"] = false
                self["#{type_prefix}_locker"].set_sensitive(false)
                toggle_che_widgets(type_prefix, true)
              end
            end
          end

          # Handle case when neither locker is active
          if !self["#{type_prefix}_horde_locker"].active? && !self["#{type_prefix}_horde_locker_che"].active?
            self["#{type_prefix}_locker"].set_sensitive(false)
            toggle_che_widgets(type_prefix, false)
          end

          # Handle case when neither list is active
          if !self["#{type_prefix}_everything_list"].active? && !self["#{type_prefix}_only_list"].active?
            disable_all(self["#{type_prefix}_everything_frame"])
            disable_all(self["#{type_prefix}_only_frame"])
          end
        end
      end

      def toggle_che_widgets(type, value)
        self["#{type}_horde_che_rooms"].set_sensitive(value)    # turn on/off CHE locker locations
        self["#{type}_horde_che_entry"].set_sensitive(value)    # turn on/off CHE locker entry verb
        self["#{type}_horde_che_exit"].set_sensitive(value)     # turn on/off CHE locker exit verb
      end

      def disable_all(container, exception: nil)
        container.each do |widget|
          next if exception && widget == exception # Skip the exception if provided

          # Disable interactive widgets
          if [Gtk::ComboBox, Gtk::ToggleButton, Gtk::Button, Gtk::TreeView].any? { |type| widget.is_a?(type) }
            widget.set_sensitive(false)
          elsif widget.is_a?(Gtk::Container)
            disable_all(widget, exception: exception) # Recurse into child containers
          else
            widget.set_sensitive(false) # Disable other non-container widgets
          end
        end
      end

      def enable_all(container)
        container.each do |child|
          child.set_sensitive(true)
          enable_all(child) if child.is_a?(Gtk::Container)
        end
      end

      def list(cat_to_list: 'all')
        indent_size = 2
        print_array =
          proc do |key, value, indent|
            _respond("#{' ' * indent_size * indent.to_i}#{key}:")
            value.sort!.each { |entry| _respond("#{' ' * indent_size * (indent.to_i + 1)}#{value.index(entry) + 1}. #{entry}") }
          end

        print_value = proc { |key, value, indent| _respond("#{' ' * indent_size * indent.to_i}#{key}: #{value}") }

        categories = cat_to_list == 'all' ? %w[loot sell skin internal] : [cat_to_list]
        if $frontend == 'stormfront'
          output = "<output class=\"mono\"/>\n"
        else
          output = String.new
        end
        categories.each do |opt|
          _respond("#{output}") if !output.empty?
          _respond("#{monsterbold_start}= #{opt.capitalize} =#{monsterbold_end}\n")
          @@categories[opt.to_sym].each do |id, _|
            value = @settings[id]
            value.is_a?(Array) ? print_array.call(id, value, 1) : print_value.call(id, value, 1)
          end
        end
        _respond("#{monsterbold_start}= GameObj Types =#{monsterbold_end}\n")
        _respond("#{GameObj.type_data.map { |k, _v| k }.sort.join(', ')}")
        if $frontend == 'stormfront'
          output = "<output class=\"\"/>\n"
          _respond("#{output}")
        end
      end

      def self.update_setting(key, value)
        setting = Setup.get_setting(key)
        ELoot.msg(type: "error", text: "** Setting \"#{key}\" does not exist") if setting.nil?

        action = nil

        if value.to_s =~ /^([+-])(.*)$/
          action = Regexp.last_match(1)
          value = Regexp.last_match(2).strip.downcase
        end

        if value.to_s == 'reset'
          @settings.delete(key)
          ELoot.msg(type: "info", text: " Reset #{key}")
        elsif @settings[key].is_a?(Array)
          if value =~ /\d/ && @settings[key][value.to_i]
            @settings[key].delete_at(value.to_i)
          else
            @settings[key].delete(value)
          end

          if action == '-'
            ELoot.msg(type: "info", text: " \"#{value}\" removed from \"#{key}\"")
          else
            @settings[key].push(value)
            ELoot.msg(type: "info", text: " \"#{value}\" added to \"#{key}\"")
          end

          ELoot.msg(type: "info", text: " \"#{key}\" is now \"#{@settings[key].join(', ')}\"")
        else
          if @settings[key].is_a?(FalseClass) || @settings[key].is_a?(TrueClass)
            value = value =~ /^true|1|yes|on/ ? true : false
          elsif @settings[key].is_a?(Integer)
            value = value.to_i
          end

          respond
          ELoot.msg(type: "yellow", text: " #{key.capitalize} has been set to #{value}")
          respond

          @settings[key] = value
        end
      end
    end

# Accept either a tattoo target or a complete RUB command. Keep the target
# explicit so a different tattoo is never selected automatically.
def valid_tattoo_input?(value)
  text = value.to_s.strip
  return true if text.empty?
  return false if text =~ /[;\r\n]/
  target = text.sub(/\Arub(?:\s+|\z)/i, '').sub(/\Amy(?:\s+|\z)/i, '').strip
  !target.empty?
end

def normalize_tattoo_command(value)
  text = value.to_s.strip
  return '' if text.empty? || !valid_tattoo_input?(text)
  return text if text =~ /\Arub\s+/i
  return "rub #{text}" if text =~ /\A(?:my\s+|#\d+\z)/i
  "rub my #{text}"
end

def parse_setting_bool(value, default)
  return default if value.nil?
  return value if value == true || value == false

  case value.to_s.strip.downcase
  when 'true', 't', '1', 'yes', 'y', 'on'
    true
  when 'false', 'f', '0', 'no', 'n', 'off'
    false
  else
    default
  end
end

def normalize_threshold_setting(value, default, minimum:)
  text = value.to_s.strip
  return default if text.empty?

  number = text.to_i
  number >= minimum ? number : default
end

def normalize_precast_setting(value, default = '')
  text = value.nil? ? default.to_s : value.to_s
  text.split(/\r?\n/).map(&:rstrip).join("\n").strip
end

def normalize_script_list_setting(value, default = '')
  parse_script_list_setting(value.nil? ? default : value).join(', ')
end

def parse_script_list_setting(value)
  value.to_s.split(/[,\r\n;]+/).map(&:strip).reject(&:empty?)
end

def precast_setting_key(ability_name)
  "energywings_precast_#{ability_name.downcase.gsub(/[^a-z0-9]+/, '_').gsub(/\A_|_\z/, '')}"

    standard_targets_entry = Gtk::Entry.new
    standard_targets_entry.text = settings[:battle_standard_min_targets].to_s

    reaction_check.active = settings[:use_prep_reaction]
    defensive_tap_check.active = settings[:use_defensive_tap]
    single_check.active = settings[:use_single_target]
    multi_check.active = settings[:use_multi_target]
    aoe_check.active = settings[:use_aoe]
    aoe_after_trample_check.active = settings[:use_aoe_after_mount_trample]
    guard_check.active = settings[:use_guard_aoe]
    compass_enable_check.active = settings[:use_leybound_compass]
    compass_t2_check.active = settings[:use_compass_t2]
    compass_t3_check.active = settings[:use_compass_t3]

    multi_threshold_entry = Gtk::Entry.new
    aoe_threshold_entry = Gtk::Entry.new
    guard_threshold_entry = Gtk::Entry.new
    [multi_threshold_entry, aoe_threshold_entry, guard_threshold_entry].each do |entry|
      entry.width_chars = 6 if entry.respond_to?(:width_chars=)
    end
    multi_threshold_entry.text = settings[:multi_target_threshold].to_s
    aoe_threshold_entry.text = settings[:aoe_target_threshold].to_s
    guard_threshold_entry.text = settings[:guard_target_threshold].to_s

    pause_bigshot_check = Gtk::CheckButton.new('Pause bigshot')
    additional_pause_scripts_entry = Gtk::Entry.new
    pause_bigshot_check.active = settings[:pause_bigshot]
    additional_pause_scripts_entry.text = settings[:additional_pause_scripts].to_s
    additional_pause_scripts_entry.width_chars = 36 if additional_pause_scripts_entry.respond_to?(:width_chars=)

    content_box = Gtk::VBox.new(false, 0)
    content_box.border_width = 5 if content_box.respond_to?(:border_width=)
    content_box.add(Gtk::HSeparator.new)
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('EnergyWings Settings'))
    content_box.add(defensive_tap_check)
    content_box.add(reaction_check)
    content_box.add(single_check)
    content_box.add(multi_check)
    content_box.add(aoe_check)
    content_box.add(aoe_after_trample_check)
    content_box.add(guard_check)
    content_box.add(Gtk::HSeparator.new)
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('Leybound Compass'))
    content_box.add(compass_enable_check)
    content_box.add(compass_t2_check)
    content_box.add(compass_t3_check)
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('Tier 3 minimum hostile targets'))
    content_box.add(compass_t3_targets_entry)
    content_box.add(Gtk::HSeparator.new)
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('Mystic Tattoo T5 (Compass T3 has priority)'))
    content_box.add(tattoo_enable_check)
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('Tattoo name or full RUB command; blank disables'))
    content_box.add(tattoo_command_entry)
    content_box.add(tattoo_error_label)
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('Mystic Surge minimum hostile targets'))
    content_box.add(tattoo_targets_entry)
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('Surge waits for Mystic Resonance and Hastened Movements to end.'))
    content_box.add(Gtk::HSeparator.new)
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('Battle Standard'))
    standard_checks.each_value { |check| content_box.add(check) }
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('Minimum hostile targets for standard abilities'))
    content_box.add(standard_targets_entry)
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('Rally and Final Stand remain manual. Restart after changing standards.'))
    content_box.add(Gtk::HSeparator.new)
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('Target thresholds'))
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('Multi-target threshold'))
    content_box.add(multi_threshold_entry)
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('AOE threshold'))
    content_box.add(aoe_threshold_entry)
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('Defensive bleeding AOE threshold'))
    content_box.add(guard_threshold_entry)
    content_box.add(Gtk::HSeparator.new)
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('Pause these scripts while wing abilities fire'))
    content_box.add(pause_bigshot_check)
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('Additional scripts to pause (comma or semicolon separated)'))
    content_box.add(additional_pause_scripts_entry)
    content_box.add(Gtk::HSeparator.new)
    content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new('Per-ability precasts (semicolon-separated commands; blank disables)'))

    DEFAULT_PRECAST_FOR_ABILITY.each do |ability_name, default_value|
      content_box.add(Gtk::Label.new("#{ability_name} precast"))
      entry = Gtk::Entry.new
      entry.text = settings[:precasts][ability_name].to_s.gsub("\n", '; ')
      entry.width_chars = 48 if entry.respond_to?(:width_chars=)
      entry.tooltip_text = "Default: #{default_value.empty? ? 'none' : default_value.gsub("\n", ' ; ')}" if entry.respond_to?(:tooltip_text=)
      precast_entries[ability_name] = entry
      content_box.add(entry)
    end

    save_btn = Gtk::Button.new('Save')
    content_box.add(Gtk::HSeparator.new)
    content_box.add(save_btn)

    scroller = Gtk::ScrolledWindow.new
    scroller.set_policy(Gtk::POLICY_AUTOMATIC, Gtk::POLICY_AUTOMATIC) if scroller.respond_to?(:set_policy)
    scroller.add_with_viewport(content_box)

    window = Gtk::Window.new
    window.title = 'EnergyWings Setup'
    window.border_width = 5
    window.set_default_size(560, 700) if window.respond_to?(:set_default_size)
    window.set_window_position(:center) if window.respond_to?(:set_window_position)
    window.set_keep_above(true) if window.respond_to?(:set_keep_above)
    window.add(scroller)

    save_btn.signal_connect('clicked') {
      Gtk.queue {
        unless valid_tattoo_input?(tattoo_command_entry.text)
          tattoo_error_label.text = 'Enter a tattoo name or one RUB command; no semicolons or extra lines.'
          next
        end
        tattoo_error_label.text = ''
        settings[:use_prep_reaction] = reaction_check.active?
        settings[:use_defensive_tap] = defensive_tap_check.active?
        settings[:use_single_target] = single_check.active?
        settings[:use_multi_target] = multi_check.active?
        settings[:use_aoe] = aoe_check.active?
        settings[:use_aoe_after_mount_trample] = aoe_after_trample_check.active?
        settings[:use_guard_aoe] = guard_check.active?
        settings[:use_leybound_compass] = compass_enable_check.active?
        settings[:use_compass_t2] = compass_t2_check.active?
        settings[:use_compass_t3] = compass_t3_check.active?
        settings[:compass_t3_min_targets] = normalize_threshold_setting(compass_t3_targets_entry.text, DEFAULT_SETTINGS[:compass_t3_min_targets], minimum: 1)
        settings[:use_mystic_tattoo] = tattoo_enable_check.active?
        settings[:mystic_tattoo_command] = normalize_tattoo_command(tattoo_command_entry.text)
        settings[:mystic_tattoo_min_targets] = normalize_threshold_setting(tattoo_targets_entry.text, DEFAULT_SETTINGS[:mystic_tattoo_min_targets], minimum: 1)
        standard_checks.each { |key, check| settings[key] = check.active? }
        settings[:battle_standard_min_targets] = normalize_threshold_setting(standard_targets_entry.text, DEFAULT_SETTINGS[:battle_standard_min_targets], minimum: 1)
        settings[:multi_target_threshold] = normalize_threshold_setting(multi_threshold_entry.text, DEFAULT_SETTINGS[:multi_target_threshold], minimum: 2)
        settings[:aoe_target_threshold] = normalize_threshold_setting(aoe_threshold_entry.text, DEFAULT_SETTINGS[:aoe_target_threshold], minimum: 2)
        settings[:guard_target_threshold] = normalize_threshold_setting(guard_threshold_entry.text, DEFAULT_SETTINGS[:guard_target_threshold], minimum: 1)
        settings[:pause_bigshot] = pause_bigshot_check.active?
        settings[:additional_pause_scripts] = normalize_script_list_setting(additional_pause_scripts_entry.text, DEFAULT_SETTINGS[:additional_pause_scripts])
        settings[:precasts] = DEFAULT_PRECAST_FOR_ABILITY.each_key.each_with_object({}) do |ability_name, precasts|
          precasts[ability_name] = normalize_precast_setting(precast_entries[ability_name].text, DEFAULT_PRECAST_FOR_ABILITY[ability_name])
        end
        save_message = "settings saved: prep_reaction=#{settings[:use_prep_reaction]} defensive_tap=#{settings[:use_defensive_tap]} single=#{settings[:use_single_target]} multi=#{settings[:use_multi_target]} aoe=#{settings[:use_aoe]} aoe_after_trample=#{settings[:use_aoe_after_mount_trample]} guard=#{settings[:use_guard_aoe]} tattoo=#{settings[:mystic_tattoo_command].empty? ? 'disabled' : settings[:mystic_tattoo_command]}"
        window_action = :save
      }
    }

    window.signal_connect('delete_event') { window_action = :cancel }
    window.show_all
    window.present if window.respond_to?(:present)
  }

  before_dying { Gtk.queue { window.destroy if window } }
  wait_while { window_action.nil? }
  undo_before_dying
  Gtk.queue { window.destroy if window }

  persist_settings(settings) if window_action == :save
  echo save_message if window_action == :save && save_message
rescue StandardError => e
  echo "setup UI error: #{e.class} #{e.message}"
end
